_comment: The same elliptical utterances as the adversarial set, now inside the conversation a person would actually have had. This is the deployment condition - the router always has the preceding turns. Comparing this against the adversarial set isolates how much of the leak rate was model failure and how much was missing context. Several conversations deliberately pair the SAME follow-up utterance with different histories, so a router that ignores context cannot score well on both.
